event.title: US Announces Oil Deal with Venezuela Amid Skepticism on Gas Prices
event.canonical_title: US Announces Oil Deal with Venezuela Amid Skepticism on Gas Prices
event.summary: The US government has announced a new oil agreement with Venezuela, granting the US majority control over 65 billion barrels of proven oil reserves. The deal, brokered through a partnership with private business, was revealed by President Trump and involves Venezuela's interim president, Delcy Rodríguez. However, energy experts express skepticism regarding the potential impact of this deal on gas prices in the US

timeline.title: US Plans Major Oil Deal with Venezuela Involving North American Blue Energy Partners
timeline.summary: The Trump administration has announced a significant oil deal with Venezuela, which is expected to involve North American Blue Energy Partners. This deal is projected to encompass around 65 billion barrels of oil reserves. Additionally, there are reports suggesting that the US may collaborate with Venezuelan oil tycoon Alejandro Betancourt, known for his ties to the Chavista regime.
